we have developed a low mass and high sensitivity electric field instrument, which has been successfully flown in space.
we have demonstrated that a double probe instrument with an active dipole and a passive dipole can provide a high quality electric field data set from a spinning spacecraft.
we have developed an electric field instrument that can be used for both spinning and non spinning spacecraft, and which can be used for a variety of missions in the inner Jovian system.

the electric field can be measured on a spinning satellite with a very low mass and power consumption instrument.
